entries.wording: 上海分拨中心 进行收件确认
entries.english: Shanghai sorting centre confirms the pickup order
entries.note: The first row: the order is confirmed before a courier collects the parcel. Listed under its words after the station.

entries.wording: 已揽收, 已收取快件
entries.english: Picked up: the parcel was collected
entries.note: Listed under its status word 已揽收, which every pickup row starts with.

entries.wording: 运送中, 快件到达 上海浦江中转场
entries.english: In transit: the parcel arrived at a transit hub
entries.note: Listed under its status word 运送中; the rows under it name the hubs and branches the parcel passes.

entries.wording: 派送中, 正在派送途中
entries.note: Listed under its status word 派送中. The live row names the courier, which is taken out.
Listed under its status word 客户签收.
